people.name: Martina Hingis
people.clue: Is a Swiss former professional tennis player. She was ranked as the world No. 1 in women's singles by the Women's Tennis Association for 209 weeks and as the world No. 1 in women's doubles for 90 weeks, holding both No. 1 rankings simultaneously for 29 weeks.

people.name: Naomi Osaka
people.clue: Is a Japanese professional tennis player. She was ranked as the world No. 1 in women's singles by the WTA for 25 weeks starting in January 2019, the first Asian player to hold the top ranking in singles.

people.name: John Michael Talbot
people.clue: Is an American Catholic musician, author, television presenter and founder of a monastic community known as the Brothers and Sisters of Charity.

people.name: Jacques Brel
people.clue: Was a Belgian singer and actor who composed and performed theatrical songs. He generated a large, devoted following—initially in Belgium and France, but later throughout the world.

people.name: Alanis Morissette
people.clue: Is a Canadian and American singer-songwriter. Regarded as the "Queen of Alt-Rock Angst", she became a cultural phenomenon in the 1990s, gaining international fame for her emotive mezzo-soprano voice and confessional songwriting.

people.name: Clara Schumann
people.clue: Was a German virtuoso pianist, composer, and piano teacher. Regarded as one of the most distinguished pianists of the Romantic era, she exerted her influence over the course of a 61-year concert career, changing the format and repertoire of the piano recital by lessening the importance of purely virtuosic works.

people.name: Agnetha Fältskog
people.clue: Is a Swedish singer and songwriter, best known as a member of the pop group ABBA. She first achieved success in Sweden with the release of her 1968 self-titled debut album.

people.name: Leonard Bernstein
people.clue: Was an American conductor, composer, pianist, music educator, author, and humanitarian. Considered to be one of the most important conductors of his time, he was the first American-born conductor to receive international acclaim.

people.name: Carl Maria von Weber
people.clue: Was a German composer, conductor, virtuoso pianist, guitarist, and critic in the late Classical and early Romantic eras. Best known for his operas, he was a crucial figure in the development of German Romantische Oper.

people.name: Joachim Löw
people.clue: Is a German football coach and former player. He was the manager of the Germany national team from 2006 until 2021. During his tenure as manager, he led Germany to victory at the 2014 FIFA World Cup in Brazil and the 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup in Russia.

people.name: David de Gea
people.clue: Quintana is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains Serie A club Fiorentina. He is regarded as one of the best goalkeepers of his generation.

people.name: Björn Borg
people.clue: Is a Swedish former professional tennis player. He was ranked as the world No. 1 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals for 109 weeks.

people.name: Ram Narayan
people.clue: Was an Indian musician who popularised the bowed instrument sarangi as a solo concert instrument in Hindustani classical music and became the first internationally successful sarangi player.

people.name: Patrick Swayze
people.clue: Was an American actor, singer-songwriter and dancer. Known for his romantic, tough, and comedic roles in blockbusters and cult films, — was nominated for three Golden Globes and received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1997.

people.name: Christoph Willibald von Gluck
people.clue: Was a composer of Italian and French opera in the early classical period. Born in the Upper Palatinate and raised in Bohemia, both part of the Holy Roman Empire at the time, he gained prominence at the Habsburg court in Vienna.

people.name: Sia
people.clue: Kate Isobelle Furler is an Australian singer and songwriter. Born and raised in Adelaide, she started her career as a singer in the acid jazz band Crisp in the mid-1990s.

people.name: Sergio Busquets
people.clue: Burgos is a Spanish former professional footballer who played as a defensive midfielder and spent most of his career at La Liga club Barcelona.

people.name: Paolo Maldini
people.clue: Is an Italian football executive and former professional footballer who most recently served as the president of the technical sector of the Italian Football Federation.

people.name: Larry Bird
people.clue: Is an American former professional basketball player, coach, and executive in the National Basketball Association. Nicknamed "the Hick from French Lick" and "— Legend", — is widely regarded as one of the greatest basketball players of all time.

people.name: Marcelo Vieira
people.clue: Is a Brazilian former professional footballer who played as a left-back. Widely regarded as one of the greatest left-backs of all time, he is known for his attacking capabilities.

people.name: Romário
people.clue: Is a Brazilian politician and former professional footballer who is currently the Senior Senator for Rio de Janeiro and the president of football club America-RJ.

people.name: Michael Owen
people.clue: Is an English former professional footballer who played as a striker for Liverpool, Real Madrid, Newcastle United, Manchester United, and Stoke City, as well as the England national team.

people.name: John Terry
people.clue: Is an English professional football coach and former player who played as a centre-back. He was previously captain of Chelsea, the England national team and Aston Villa.

people.name: Paulo Dybala
people.clue: Is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for the Serie A club Roma and the Argentina national team. He is nicknamed "La Joya".

people.name: Eric Cantona
people.clue: Is a French actor and former professional footballer. In his football career, — was a physically strong and technically skilful player with both creative and goalscoring ability.

people.name: Luís Figo
people.clue: Is a Portuguese former professional footballer who played as a winger for Sporting CP, Barcelona, Real Madrid, and Inter Milan. He won 127 caps for the Portugal national team, a one-time record.

people.name: Casemiro
people.clue: Is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami and the Brazil national team.

people.name: Jude Bellingham
people.clue: Is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the England national team.

people.name: Yelena Isinbayeva
people.clue: Is a Russian former pole vaulter. She is twice an Olympic gold medalist, three-times a World Champion, the current world record holder in the event, and is widely considered the greatest female pole-vaulter of all time.

people.name: Garrincha
people.clue: Was a Brazilian professional footballer who played as a right winger. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, and by many, one of the greatest dribblers ever.

people.name: Carles Puyol
people.clue: Saforcada is a Spanish former professional footballer who played his entire career for Barcelona. Considered one of the best defenders ever and one of the sport's greatest captains, he mainly played as a centre-back, but could also play in either full-back position, mostly as a right-back.

people.name: Jordi Alba
people.clue: Ramos is a Spanish former professional footballer who played as a left-back. He is often regarded as one of the best full-backs of his generation.

people.name: Jérôme Boateng
people.clue: Is a German former professional footballer who played as a centre-back. — started his career at Hertha BSC where he developed from the youth ranks to the first team.

people.name: Rivaldo
people.clue: Is a Brazilian former professional footballer who played primarily as an attacking midfielder or second striker, while also operating as a left winger.

people.name: Pete Sampras
people.clue: Is an American former professional tennis player. One of the most successful tennis players of all time, he was ranked as the world No. 1 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals for 286 weeks, and finished as the year-end No. 1 six consecutive times.

people.name: Boris Becker
people.clue: Is a German former professional tennis player, tennis coach and a commentator. He was ranked as the world No. 1 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals.

people.name: Marco Reus
people.clue: Is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club LA Galaxy. — spent his youth career at Borussia Dortmund, prior to leaving for Rot Weiss Ahlen.

people.name: Hernán Crespo
people.clue: Is an Argentine professional football coach and former player. He is considered one of the best strikers in the history of the Argentina national team.

people.name: Son Heung-min
people.clue: Is a South Korean professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Major League Soccer club Los Angeles FC and captains the South Korea national team.

people.name: Edwin van der Sar
people.clue: Is a Dutch football executive and former player. Widely regarded as one of the greatest goalkeepers of all time, he was most recently the chief executive of Eredivisie club Ajax.

people.name: Didier Deschamps
people.clue: Is a French professional football manager and former player. He played as a defensive midfielder for several clubs in France, Italy, England and Spain, namely Marseille, Juventus, Chelsea and Valencia, as well as Nantes and Bordeaux.

people.name: Raphaël Varane
people.clue: Is a French former professional footballer who played as a centre-back. Often called the term "Rolls-Royce" defender in football, he is regarded as one of the best defenders of his generation.

people.name: Riyad Mahrez
people.clue: Is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Qatar Stars League side Al-Shamal. Born in France, he represented the Algeria national team.

people.name: Stephen Curry
people.clue: Is an American professional basketball player for the Golden State Warriors of the National Basketball Association, where he plays as a point guard.

people.name: Jürgen Klinsmann
people.clue: Is a German professional football manager and former player. He played for several prominent clubs in Europe including VfB Stuttgart, Inter Milan, Monaco, Tottenham Hotspur, and Bayern Munich.

people.name: Robinho
people.clue: Is a Brazilian former professional footballer who played as a forward. In 1996, at 12 years of age, — was picked by Brazil legend Pelé as his heir apparent and, in 2002, went on to lead Santos to their first Campeonato Brasileiro title since Pelé himself played for the club.

people.name: Wesley Sneijder
people.clue: Is a Dutch former professional footballer who played as an attacking midfielder. A product of the Ajax Youth Academy, — started his professional career playing for Ajax, with whom he won four trophies and was awarded the Johan Cruyff Trophy in 2004.

people.name: Dennis Bergkamp
people.clue: Is a Dutch professional football coach and former player. Originally a wide midfielder, — was moved to main striker while still a teenager and then played as a deeper lying forward for the remainder of his career.

people.name: Mario Götze
people.clue: Is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or forward for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt.

people.name: Jordan Henderson
people.clue: Is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Chelsea and the England national team. He is known for his leadership, versatility, and physicality.

people.name: Louis van Gaal
people.clue: Is a Dutch former football player and manager. At club level, he served as manager of Ajax, Barcelona, AZ, Bayern Munich and Manchester United, as well as having three spells in charge of the Netherlands national team.

people.name: N'Golo Kanté
people.clue: Is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the France national team.

people.name: Billie Jean King
people.clue: Is an American former world No. 1 tennis player. — won 39 Grand Slam titles: 12 in singles, 16 in women's doubles, and 11 in mixed doubles.

people.name: Ruud van Nistelrooy
people.clue: Is a Dutch professional football manager and former player. He is currently working as an assistant coach of the Netherlands national football team.

people.name: Zico
people.clue: Is a Brazilian football coach and former player who played as an attacking midfielder. A creative playmaker with excellent technical skills, vision and an eye for goal, he is widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, and also considered one of the best free kick specialists in history.

people.name: Carlos Tevez
people.clue: Is an Argentine professional football manager and former player. A dynamic forward in his prime, — was capable of playing as a striker, as a winger, as a supporting forward, or as an attacking midfielder.

people.name: Sami Khedira
people.clue: Is a German former professional footballer who played as a central midfielder. He is currently the assistant coach of La Liga club Real Madrid.

people.name: Bastian Schweinsteiger
people.clue: Is a German former professional footballer who played as a midfielder. Earlier in his career, he primarily played as a wide midfielder before later switching to a central midfield role.

people.name: Yaya Touré
people.clue: Is an Ivorian professional football coach and former player who is the head coach of Slovak First Football League club Slovan Bratislava.

people.name: Arturo Vidal
people.clue: Is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for Liga de Primera club Colo-Colo and the Chile national team.

people.name: David Silva
people.clue: Is a Spanish professional footballer who currently plays as a central or an attacking midfielder for Hong Kong Premier League club Sha Tin.

people.name: Diego Godín
people.clue: Is a Uruguayan former professional footballer who played as a centre-back. Regarded as one of the best defenders of his generation, he started out at Cerro and three years later was transferred to Primera División side Nacional.

people.name: Philippe Coutinho
people.clue: Correia is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Santos.

people.name: Raheem Sterling
people.clue: Is a professional footballer who plays as a winger. He is currently a free agent. Born in Jamaica, he has played for the England national team.

people.name: Pepe
people.clue: Is a former professional footballer who played as a centre-back. He is regarded as one of the greatest defenders of his generation.

people.name: Gonzalo Higuaín
people.clue: Is an Argentine professional football coach and former player who played as a striker. He is a player development coach for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami.

people.name: Carl Lewis
people.clue: Is an American former track and field athlete who won nine Olympic gold medals, one Olympic silver medal, and 10 World Championships medals, including eight gold.

people.name: Victoria Azarenka
people.clue: Is a Belarusian inactive tennis player. She has been ranked as the world No. 1 in singles by the WTA and held the position for a total of 51 weeks, including as the year-end No. 1 in 2012.

people.name: John McEnroe
people.clue: Is an American former professional tennis player. Often ranked amongst the greatest tennis players of all time, — was ranked as the world No. 1 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals for 170 weeks.

people.name: Steve Ballmer
people.clue: Is an American businessman and investor who was the chief executive officer of Microsoft from 2000 to 2014. He is the owner of the Los Angeles Clippers of the National Basketball Association, and a co-founder of the — Group, a philanthropic investment company.

people.name: Mats Hummels
people.clue: Is a German former professional footballer who played as a centre-back. Considered one of the best defenders of his generation, he was known for his tackling, anticipation, goal scoring ability and deadly crosses.

people.name: Pepe Reina
people.clue: Is a Spanish former professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper, and is the current manager of Villarreal CF's Juvenil A squad.

people.name: Ruud Gullit
people.clue: Is a Dutch former professional footballer and manager. Known for his ability to play multiple positions, he won the 1987 Ballon d'Or and was a long-time Netherlands national team captain, leading them to the UEFA Euro 1988 title.

people.name: Petr Čech
people.clue: Is a Czech former professional football goalkeeper and current ice hockey goaltender who plays for the Haringey Huskies of the NIHL Division 2 South.

people.name: Alan Shearer
people.clue: Is an English football pundit and former professional player who played as a striker. With 260 goals, — is the Premier League's all-time record goalscorer.

people.name: Kevin Durant
people.clue: Is an American professional basketball player for the Houston Rockets of the National Basketball Association. Nicknamed "the Slim Reaper", he is widely regarded as one of the greatest basketball players and one of the greatest scorers of all time.

people.name: Víctor Valdés
people.clue: Arribas is a Spanish football coach and former professional player who played as a goalkeeper. He spent most of his professional career with Barcelona in La Liga appearing in 535 official games whilst winning 21 major titles.

people.name: Lilian Thuram
people.clue: Is a French author, philanthropist and former professional footballer who played as a defender. He was capable of playing both as a centre-back or as a right-back, and helped both offensively and defensively.

people.name: Alexis Sánchez
people.clue: Is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a winger or a striker for Major League Soccer club CF Montréal and the Chile national team.

people.name: Virgil van Dijk
people.clue: Is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for and captains both Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.

people.name: Henrikh Mkhitaryan
people.clue: Is an Armenian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Inter Milan. He is the all time top goalscorer for the Armenia national team.

people.name: Keisuke Honda
people.clue: Is a Japanese professional football manager and player who plays as a midfielder for Singapore Premier League side Jurong. A versatile player, — can also play as a winger, a false nine or a deep-lying playmaker.

people.name: Juan Mata Pata
people.clue: Is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder, most recently for A-League Men club Melbourne Victory. He primarily plays as an attacking midfielder, but can also play as a winger.

people.name: Rio Ferdinand
people.clue: Is an English former professional footballer who played as a centre-back, and was a television pundit for TNT Sports, for ten years.

people.name: Nani
people.clue: Is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger. He is known for his pace, flair and work ethic. — began his career with Sporting CP, joining the youth team in 2003 before making his first-team debut in 2005.

people.name: Alisson Becker
people.clue: Is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper and serves as vice-captain for Premier League club Liverpool and the Brazil national team.

people.name: Rodri
people.clue: Is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and captains the Spain national team.

people.name: Achraf Hakimi
people.clue: Mouh is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain. Born in Spain, he plays for and captains the Morocco national team.

people.name: Conor McGregor
people.clue: Is an Irish professional mixed martial artist. He is a former Ultimate Fighting Championship Featherweight and Lightweight Champion, becoming the first fighter to hold UFC championships in two weight classes simultaneously.

people.name: Paul Scholes
people.clue: Is an English former professional footballer, pundit, and coach. Widely regarded as one of the greatest midfielders of his generation, — spent his entire professional playing career with Manchester United, for whom he scored over 150 goals in more than 700 appearances between 1993 and 2013.

people.name: Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang
people.clue: Is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Deportivo A Coruña. Born in France, he played for the Gabon national team.

people.name: Giorgio Chiellini
people.clue: Is an Italian former professional footballer who played as a centre-back or left-back. Considered one of the best defenders of all time, — was known for his strength, aggressiveness, man-marking, and ability to play in either a three or four-man defence.

people.name: David Luiz
people.clue: Moreira Marinho is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Cypriot First Division club Pafos. He is primarily a centre-back, but has also been deployed as a defensive midfielder.

people.name: Kevin Keegan
people.clue: Was an English football player and manager who played as an attacking midfielder or forward. Nicknamed "King Kev" or "Mighty Mouse", — was recognised for his dribbling ability, finishing and presence in the air, as much as he was for his distinctive appearance and charismatic personality.

people.name: Javier Mascherano
people.clue: Is an Argentine football manager and former player who was most recently the head coach of Major League Soccer club Inter Miami.

people.name: Thiago Silva
people.clue: Is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Fluminense. Widely regarded as one of the best defenders of his generation, he is one of a select number of players who have amassed over 1,000 career appearances.

people.name: Diego Costa
people.clue: Is a former professional footballer who played as a striker. Born in Brazil, he played for the Spain national team. — began his career in his native Brazil before joining Braga in Portugal in 2006, aged 17.

people.name: Manny Pacquiao
people.clue: Is a Filipino professional boxer and former politician. Nicknamed "PacMan", he is widely regarded as one of the greatest professional boxers of all time, becoming the only eight-division world champion in boxing history.

people.name: Kim Clijsters
people.clue: Is a Belgian former professional tennis player. She was ranked as the world No. 1 in women's singles by the Women's Tennis Association for 20 weeks, and as the world No. 1 in women's doubles for 4 weeks, having held both rankings simultaneously in 2003.

people.name: Joe Frazier
people.clue: Was an American professional boxer who competed from 1965 to 1981. Nicknamed "Smokin’ Joe”, he was known for his strength, durability, formidable left hand, and relentless pressure fighting style.

people.name: Mario Gómez
people.clue: García is a German former professional footballer who played as a striker. He represented the Germany national team over a period of 11 years between 2007 and 2018.

people.name: Patrick Vieira
people.clue: Is a French professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of the Senegal national team. Widely regarded as among the best players of his generation and one of the greatest midfielders of all time, he was named in the FIFA 100 of the greatest living footballers in 2004.

people.name: Javier Zanetti
people.clue: Is an Argentine former professional footballer. Spending nearly all his career at Inter Milan, — was known for his versatility and adeptness, often playing as full-back or wing-back on both flanks, and as a midfielder.

people.name: Hidetoshi Nakata
people.clue: Is a Japanese former professional footballer who played as a midfielder. Considered as one of the greatest Asian football players of all time and coming from an Asian Football Confederation country in the late 1990s and early 2000s, — became the first ever AFC player to be nominated for the Ballon d'Or.

people.name: Ashley Cole
people.clue: Is an English professional football coach and former player who was most recently the head coach of Serie B club Cesena. As a player, he played as a left-back, most notably for Arsenal and Chelsea.

people.name: Wojciech Szczęsny
people.clue: Is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Barcelona. After starting his club career at Legia Warsaw, — signed for Arsenal in January 2006, where he made his professional debut in 2009.

people.name: Harry Maguire
people.clue: Is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Manchester United and the England national team.

people.name: Aaron Ramsey
people.clue: Is a Welsh professional football manager and former player who is head coach of EFL League One club Oxford United. He manly played as a box-to-box midfielder, but had also been deployed on the left and right wings.

people.name: Arda Turan
people.clue: Is a Turkish professional football manager and former player who is currently the head coach of Ukrainian Premier League club Shakhtar Donetsk.
